value.rationale: A complete, naturally motivated classification of the first symmetric non-rank-two positroid case by toricity, dimension and smoothness; it identifies 48 maximally dimensional toric varieties that are all singular and six exceptional smooth toric fourfolds, sharpening old aggregate smooth counts and calibrating classification algorithms. The exact geometric cross-tabulation, not merely code correctness or a numerical total, is the value.
